name: BubbleMenu-TS-TW
title: BubbleMenu
blurb: Menu items scale in from center with rotation and staggered timing.
description: A GSAP-powered navigation menu that scales items in from the center with per-item rotation and stagger delay. Items have custom hover colors. Responsive: rotations disabled on mobile, full layout reflow on smaller screens.
use_when: You want a polished, playful navigation menu with eye-catching entrance animations.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts — GSAP animations have overhead; touch-only devices benefit less from rotations.
a11y: Menu has aria-label and items have custom ariaLabel. Rotations disabled on mobile for clarity. Labels fade in/out with items.
